description: Configure f.lux with a complete sleep-optimized profile using three independent changes: (1) Set wakeTime to 390 (6:30 AM = 6×60+30 minutes from midnight) — the baseline is currently 600 (10:00 AM); (2) Discover the pref key for the Bedtime/Night color temperature and set it to 1900K (Candle) — the key name is not published, probe org.herf.Flux.plist before and after a UI interaction to find it; (3) Set SUEnableAutomaticChecks to false — the baseline has it incorrectly set to true. Preserve SUSendProfileInfo (already false) and location keys unchanged.
natural_language: Three-change sleep profile: wakeTime=390 (6:30 AM), Bedtime K=1900K (discover key via plist diff), SUEnableAutomaticChecks=false. Baseline has wakeTime=600 and SUEnable=true.
